verdict.rationale: Gemini's docs say users can upload photos to get answers, summaries, and insights about their content, and on Android can ask Gemini for help with what's on screen, which covers the core of the story. Hands-on reports on accuracy are mixed. One user replaced an OCR vendor at about 96% of the vendor's accuracy. Others report inaccurate bounding boxes and a misread trick image, though in that case it still noticed the anomaly. missing for 10: dedicated first-party docs on screenshot interpretation, any stated accuracy claims or limits for image understanding, consistent independent evidence of accurate interpretation of everyday screenshots/photos.
